title: Features Quiz
description: Check your understanding of Copilot Chat, CLI, slash commands, and integrations.

questions.text: What is the keyboard shortcut to accept a GitHub Copilot inline suggestion in VS Code?
Which Copilot Chat slash command generates unit tests for selected code?
What does the @workspace participant in Copilot Chat do?

options.text: Switches your VS Code workspace configuration
Allows you to ask questions about your entire project codebase
Shares your workspace with another developer

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of GitHub Copilot CLI?

options.text: To deploy applications to cloud providers via the terminal
To replace the GitHub CLI (gh) tool entirely
To bring AI assistance to terminal commands — explaining and suggesting shell commands
To generate GitHub Actions workflow files

questions.text: GitHub Copilot can automatically generate a pull request description based on the code diff.
